records.found: Vertex's third-quarter 2026 results (listed as 2026-11-02; the page itself carries no date line) say it has 'decided to focus on accelerating the development of VX-017', a second islet-cell treatment for type 1 diabetes, which 'has the potential to reach more patients than zimislecel', and that VX-017 moves into pivotal development in 2027. The release says nothing on a filing for zimislecel. The entry's clinic years (2030, 2032, 2046) rest on zimislecel being filed and approved, so a company turning its effort to a different product points to a later date; the careful reading is that it is against the current likely year, pending Vertex's promised updated timelines.

findings.what: Vertex third-quarter 2026 results: focus moved to VX-017 over zimislecel (zimislecel 'designed for patients with blood types A or A/B only'); VX-017 in a phase 1/2 trial with Fast Track status; pivotal development planned 2027; no zimislecel filing mentioned. Date taken from the search listing 'Vertex Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results November 2, 2026'; the filed exhibit itself shows no date.

Registry: two new or updated Chinese phase 1/2 trials of UX-DA003, a stem-cell-derived treatment for Parkinson's disease (NCT07911670 first posted; NCT07733349 updated 2026-11-04). Titles and status read from the registry listing only.
Registry record for the Vertex trial of VX-880 and VX-017 (NCT04786262) last updated 2026-09-01, recruiting, no results posted. Before the window; it shows VX-017 is already in the same trial.
Healio report on patient-reported outcomes in the 12 people given zimislecel (diabetes distress and fear of low blood sugar fell over the year). Before the window; secondary report only.

A Vertex investor slide deck found by search (undated) says global regulatory submissions for zimislecel began in the first half of 2026. This contradicts the entry ('No filing has been announced') and the Q3 text; I could not date or open it, so treat as unverified.

records.found: The registry shows a new pig-kidney trial record, ChoironeX's 'GalKO Porcine Thymokidney' phase 1 study in end-stage kidney disease (NCT07696962, first posted 2026-07-10, updated 2026-11-02, recruiting, 4 participants planned, start estimated 2026-10). It is a further xenotransplant trial, not a new approval or a patient report, so it does not move the clinic rung. The entry also lacks two older facts: the FDA cleared a pig-heart trial from United Therapeutics on 2026-05-15, and a Lancet case report in September 2026 described a pig kidney bridging a patient to a human kidney.

findings.what: Registry record updated for the ChoironeX GalKO Porcine Thymokidney trial (Xeno Holdings (US), LLC dba ChoironeX); phase 1, recruiting, 4 participants estimated.
